messages:
alex: quick pre-swing check — leaving notes for next shift. what i did: rotated eu-west kvcache nodes out of maintenance, confirmed canary traffic on v2 routing is stable (~0.5% p95 drop but healthy), applied patch for double-counting tokens in billing meter.
mira: thanks alex. did you push the billing patch to prod or just staging?
alex: pushed to prod at 02:10 UTC. small migration job ran, logs looked clean. i left the migration in 'done' state. no schema changes.
sam: current incidents? last I saw there was increased embed latency for some tenants.
alex: embed latency spike resolved — cause was noisy neighbor on a dedicated pod in eu-west1. evicted pod, autoscaler triggered new pod. latency back to baseline. affected tenants notified via status page. mitigation: tightened node affinity and added eviction threshold to 75%.
jorge: noted. any ongoing alerts in pagerduty we should watch?
oncall-bot: ALERT: embed-latency-eu-west1 alert recovered at 3185558500 (duration 12m).
lee: small blocker — the canary for gen-regression flagged 2 prompts with differences > threshold. not sure if it's model drift or tokenization mismatch.
mira: can you paste the failing prompt ids? we should run the eval harness locally.
lee: prompt ids 78921, 78924. quick diff:
```
- expected: "Your itinerary includes..."
+ actual: "Your itinerary includes the following steps..."
```
looks like an extra template was appended by the new postprocess step in the transform pipeline.
alex: rollback ready if needed. i've disabled the postprocess step on canary route until lee confirms.
lee: thanks — i'll run a targeted eval against v2-canary. should have results in ~20m.
sam: FYI i've got a PR open (https://git.internal/r/redwood/optimize/pulls/412) for smarter batching that reduces small-request overhead. needs one more review.
mira: pinged in PR, i'll take a look after standup.
jorge: ops todo for next shift: 1) verify autoscaler cooldown adjustments in eu-west1, 2) run the eval of the two prompts on canary, 3) confirm billing meter metrics for yesterday's spike (ticket #4567).
alex: added those to the shift checklist. also note: quiet maintenance tonight on infra-db from 04:00-04:30 UTC — expect brief failovers, don't escalate unless >5m sustained error rate.
oncall-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance (infra-db) starts 04:00 UTC — channel #incidents will mirror major events.
lee: eval done — both prompts show extra suffix from postprocess, regression confirmed. creating rollback PR now.
lee: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/transform/pulls/129 — rollback to previous postprocess by toggling feature flag.
sam: once it's merged i'll coordinate deploy. aim for a 2-step canary -> full rollout with health checks.
mira: if rollback goes through, please run the quick smoke: `curl -sS https://canary.redwood/api/health && ./scripts/run-eval --ids 78921,78924`
alex: i will be offline at 03:10-04:00 UTC for maintenance window. mira/sam please watch the deploy if it happens during that time.
mira: copy that.
jorge: leaving these reminders in ops doc: https://docs.internal/ops/shift-checks/pre-swing-3185556789
alex: thanks team. summary for next shift: embed latency incident recovered, billing patch deployed, rollback PR for postprocess pending, autoscaler tuning in eu-west to verify. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
